name: FastAPI
subtitle: Async Python API framework
creator: Sebastián Ramírez
description: A framework for building HTTP APIs using Python type hints. Those hints drive request validation, serialization and automatic interactive documentation. It is async-native and built on Starlette and Pydantic.

concepts.explanation: Declared types are checked on every request.
Classes that describe request and response bodies.
